name: hardening-dev-environment
description: Hardens the developer environment against npm supply chain attacks and prompt-injection-driven attacks on Claude Code. Generates pnpm 10.26+ config and migrates `npx` to `pnpm dlx`; generates mode-agnostic `.claude/settings.json` deny/ask rules and a Claude Code v2.1.83+ auto-mode overlay (defaultMode + classifier backstops on outbound Bash and remote-egress); bundles PreToolUse hooks that block sensitive Bash reads and `package.json` `scripts` tampering, and a PostToolUse hook that marks non-vendor `WebFetch` results as untrusted external data.
